HAND SCALE / Lots, texts, names & numbers

Gematria & isopsephy.

Letter-number interpretation within particular writing systems, including Hebrew and Greek traditions.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Gematria
Gematría

Interpretation involving the numerical values of letters, particularly within Hebrew textual traditions.

Isopsephy
Isopsefía

Greek letter-number calculation and comparison, including words or phrases with equal totals.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Gematria and Greek isopsephy depend on their languages’ letter values and textual conventions. Transliteration or a changed spelling can change a sum; numerical equality alone does not establish a shared historical meaning.

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Identify the original script, spelling and value table.
  2. Show each letter value and the complete sum without silently changing the text.
  3. Separate the computed equality from the proposed textual or symbolic connection.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Send the original text and a legible table of letter values.
  • Include the manuscript or edition reference and indicate any uncertain characters.
